text: Assumption: Because Offer is specified as not thread-safe, synchronization of parallel calls is the responsibility of the calling application — is this correct?

assumption: Because Offer is specified as not thread-safe, synchronization of parallel calls is the responsibility of the calling application.
rationale: The specification indicates the thread safety as not thread-safe, but defines no internal synchronization mechanisms.
